tasks.title: Strict role coverage
tasks.statement: The target role has **{n}** skills. All modules are mastered for **{f}** skills, some for **{p}**, and the rest have not been started. Find the strict coverage of the role, %.
tasks.solution: Strict coverage counts only fully covered skills: f / N × 100 %. Partly covered skills are not included, and neither are modules outside the role's list.

tasks.title: Weighted role coverage
tasks.statement: The target role has **{n}** skills. All modules are mastered for **{f}** skills, some for **{p}**, and the rest have not been started. Find the weighted coverage (a partial skill = 0.5), %.
tasks.solution: Weighted coverage = (f + 0.5·p) / N × 100 %. The module's example: (3 + 0.5·4) / 10 = 50 %. Counting partial skills as whole gives the inflated (f + p) / N.

tasks.title: Weeks to close the gaps
tasks.statement: The role's gaps are **{m}** modules averaging **{h}** h each in the course program, plus **{q}** h of their prerequisites that you do not have. You have **{w}** h per week for study. How many full weeks do you need (rounded up)?
tasks.solution: Hours = m·h + q; weeks = ⌈hours / w⌉. The module's example: 32 h of gaps without prerequisites at 6 h per week → ⌈32/6⌉ = 6 weeks. Without q the plan comes out shorter than reality.
